title: Pure Karakuri
summary: Karakuri cards only, with untagged EARTH Machine Extra Deck monsters, Links and staples. Karakuri are EARTH Machines that must attack and flip to Defense when targeted, and the deck turns those battle position changes into value. Karakuri Merchant searches any Karakuri card when Normal Summoned, and Karakuri Cash Cache adds a Level 4 or lower Karakuri while flipping one. The 2020 cards lead. Karakuri Bonze changes a Karakuri's battle position to summon itself as a Tuner. Karakuri Gama flips one from the GY on either turn, and Karakuri Cash Inn negates a monster by flipping yours. Each Karakuri Shogun summons another Karakuri from the Deck when Synchro Summoned, and Karakuri Super Shogun banishes a card every time a Karakuri changes position. Bonze locks the Extra Deck to EARTH Machines for the turn, so the Extra Deck leans on Shoguns and untagged EARTH Machines.
